entries.title: Numbers 12:1
segments: ¶And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had taken; for he had taken a Cushite as wife.

entries.title: Numbers 12:2
segments: And they said, Has Jehovah indeed spoken only to Moses? has he not spoken also to us? And Jehovah heard it.

entries.title: Numbers 12:3
segments: But the man Moses was very meek, above all men that were upon the face of the earth.

entries.title: Numbers 12:4
segments: ¶Then Jehovah spoke suddenly to Moses, and to Aaron, and to Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tent of meeting. And they went out, they three.

entries.title: Numbers 12:5
segments: And Jehovah came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood at the entrance of the tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forth.

entries.title: Numbers 12:6
segments: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I Jehovah will make myself known to him in a vision, I will speak to him in a dream.

entries.title: Numbers 12:7
segments: Not so my servant Moses: he is faithful in all my house.

entries.title: Numbers 12:8
segments: Mouth to mouth do I speak to him openly, and not in riddles; and the form of Jehovah doth he behold. Why then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?

entries.title: Numbers 12:9
segments: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against them, and he went away;

entries.title: Numbers 12:10
segments: ¶and the cloud departed from off the tent. And behold, Miriam was leprous as snow; and Aaron turned toward Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

entries.title: Numbers 12:11
segments: Then Aaron said to Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not this sin upon us, wherein we have been foolish, and have sinned!

entries.title: Numbers 12:12
segments: Let her not be as one stillborn, half of whose flesh is consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb.

entries.title: Numbers 12:13
segments: And Moses cried to Jehovah, saying, O *God, heal her, I beseech thee!

entries.title: Numbers 12:14
segments: And Jehovah said to Moses, But had her father anyways spat in her face, should she not be shamed seven days? She shall be shut outside the camp seven days, and afterwards she shall be received in [again].

entries.title: Numbers 12:15
segments: And Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days; and the people did not journey till Miriam was received in [again].

entries.title: Numbers 12:16
segments: And afterwards the people journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
